profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Pipe
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Designed and built a Java-based utility tool that automates content migration between two content management systems. Implemented one-to-one mapping, made RESTful API calls, and logged results to preserve content integrity. Collaborated with client to customize tool for their needs. 

•	Implemented multithreading to improve performance.

•	Practiced agile methodologies to improve code base including iterative development and code reviews.

•	Used tool to automate the mapping and migration of 600+ files and assets used in production.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated with software development team, testing and debugging software in production. Worked closely with mentor to understand web application and enterprise software development and principles. Participated in daily stand-ups and shadowed sprint planning meetings to experience Agile methodology in practice.

•	Tested and debugged both front-end and back-end of data recording web applications written in JavaScript and Java. Used Chrome Web Developer Tools, Eclipse IDE, and Toad for Oracle.

•	Developed full-stack CRUD web application backed with a MySQL database that implements RESTful architecture with Spring MVC framework.
